analysis: AGENTS.md is documentation only (no executable code). The diff changes the Releases section (base lines 264-271 -> head 264-273), the release-sensitive note at base 298 -> head 300, and the sync-point bullet at base 327 -> head 329. It removes the requirement that LatestProviderVersion in coordinator/api/server.go be bumped together with ProviderCore.version, requires a signed annotated vX.Y.Z tag, and says scripts/check-release-version.sh binds the requested version and the built binary to the source version. It also states that coordinator work belongs in darkbloom-platform and that the retained coordinator copy is not a provider release input. These are process-guidance changes with no direct effect on controls tied to A-005/A-011/A-017 (release registration, binary hash registry, build qualification) or T-025/T-034/T-054. Nothing in this PR shows the check script or the release workflow changing, so any weakening of the provider release controls cannot be confirmed from here. No new attack surface, no invalidated threat assumptions, and no required threat-model update were found. Coverage limit: the check-release-version.sh implementation and the release-swift.yml workflow were not supplied, so the claim that the script binds the built binary to the source version is not verified. The remaining ~200 lines of the AGENTS.md hunks are unchanged from base to head.
